notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two creatures with defender.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Marvin using Axebane Guardian's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
